question: Should Crabpot retain the current qqbot compatibility pin at `3eee789`, or intentionally sponsor and validate an upgrade to `47142c9`?
rationale: The branch predates the current-main pin choice, the upstream range is behaviorally broad, and the focused fixture check fails, so automation cannot safely decide that overwriting the selected baseline is intended.

options.title: Retain current pin
options.body: Leave `3eee789` on main and close or replace this stale Dependabot branch when a validated upgrade is ready.

options.title: Sponsor fresh upgrade
options.body: Recreate the update from current main, refresh any changed report expectations, and merge only after the isolated qqbot lane passes.

recommendation.title: Retain current pin
recommendation.body: Leave `3eee789` on main and close or replace this stale Dependabot branch when a validated upgrade is ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent fixture, dependency, CI, and dashboard history is closest to the compatibility-pin decision.
